_purpose: Append-only demand log for evidence that was cut from an application because it was not grounded. One record per bullet per application. Demand count is the priority queue: ground the most-demanded bullets first. Created 2026-08-13 after the BJAK draft lost six on-target bullets whose loss would otherwise have existed only in a chat transcript.
_contract: craft-cv appends here. It never edits MasterExperienceDB.json. A bullet's status changes only in a grounding session with Chukwan, recorded in the DB with a source and date.
_key: Bullets have no stable IDs yet, so records key on a short descriptor plus role. Migrate to bullet IDs when DATA-REDESIGN.md is applied.
